name: UPSCALE REFINE - FLUX.2 Klein 4B
author: Pfannkuchensack
description: Callable upscale + refine sub workflow (FLUX.2 Klein 4B). Image in, image + latents + metadata out.
tags: callable, sub workflow, upscale, refine, FLUX.2 Klein 4B
notes:
Pfannkuchensacks Workflow Package

Callable sub workflow for the "Call Saved Workflow" node.

Returns three named values:
  image     - the finished image (use this to chain into the next call)
  latents   - the raw latents (usable, but the editor cannot wire a LatentsField
              into a Call Saved Workflow node yet, so chain on "image")
  metadata  - core metadata for the run

Every workflow in this series uses the SAME node ids and field names for its
shared inputs, so swapping the selected workflow on a Call Saved Workflow node
keeps the existing wiring intact.

Note: the model is set on the loader node inside this workflow. It is not written
into the metadata, because the Z-Image and Krea-2 loaders only accept a directly
selected model (Input.Direct) and no loader outputs a model identifier, so there
is no single source of truth to wire into core_metadata.model.

Set "Width"/"Height" to the TARGET resolution (i.e. the upscaled size). The
incoming image is resized to exactly that size, encoded with the model's own
VAE, and re-denoised starting at "Denoising Start".

Width/Height are explicit rather than derived from the encoder, because
LatentsOutput.build() indexes latents.size()[2]/[3] and therefore reports a
bogus height for the 5D (B,C,1,H,W) latents used by Krea-2 / Qwen-Image /
Anima. Driving img_resize and the denoise node from the same two fields also
guarantees the encoded size matches the denoise size exactly, with no
grid-rounding drift.

data.content: FLUX.2 Klein 4B: the CFG field drives "guidance". The Qwen3 encoder MUST match the transformer size (4B->Qwen3 4B, 9B->Qwen3 8B) - the loader rejects a mismatched pair.
